title: Weak-Component Removal as a Shared-Capital Portfolio Counterfactual

research_height.transfer_path: Removing one low-yield component changes direct lifecycle value, then shared slot/risk occupancy and admission of the remaining five components, and finally whole-account stressed net, equity drawdown and turnover.

central_question: Does removing Passive or Return from the unchanged six-component shared account improve whole-portfolio value and equity drawdown broadly by releasing enough real slot and risk capacity to offset the removed component's contribution?

research_bundle.name: three_contract_real_tick_portfolio_value_capacity_and_externality_matrix
lenses: portfolio result: stressed net plus actual maximum equity drawdown in four fixed fresh-account periods
capacity transmission: total and remaining-component births, risk skips, stop rate and turnover retention
component-set externality: remaining-five stressed net and births versus the identical remaining components under NATIVE

idea_provenance.authority_note: The memo's broad weak-component claim is narrowed to exactly two predeclared single removals. A component is not declared redundant from its standalone net; only an actual shared-account counterfactual can pass.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Units 072-074 found that the US100 book is profitable but lower-yield, recorded entry costs do not distinguish Passive, and turnover has an unstable negative value relationship. Unit 080 found no actionable RC16 supply-decay explanation. The unresolved implementation decision is whether low-yield fills consume economically valuable shared capacity or supply useful breadth.
why_now.connection_bridge: Passive and Return together supplied a large historical fill share for a small historical net share, while all current capital, risk and slots are shared first-come. Removing either can therefore improve or damage the remaining portfolio through an actual admission externality that source-free lifecycle subtraction cannot identify.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 080 was Program 1 meso pre-entry feature supply over one strategy. Unit 081 changes program, height, causal treatment and data role to a whole-contract Program 5 macro intervention with normal real-tick shared-account outcomes.
why_now.decision_if_true: Freeze the winning five-component contract as one future Lab candidate only. Do not promote it to Live or remove another component automatically.
why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve all six components and close the component-removal axis without combined removal, another component, a period rescue or parameter adjustment.
why_now.decision_if_ambiguous_or_invalid: Make no component, capital, risk, slot, turnover or Live change; preserve the six-component baseline and record the execution or identification boundary.

whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Unit 076 closed internal-dispersion conditioning negative and no current external-event bridge outranks the shared-capital contract question.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Cards 14, 15, 18 and 19 are either structurally sparse, Passive-specific, newly closed invalid or require a new shadow logger; none changes the whole portfolio as directly.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: Cards 20, 21, 24 and 26 are closed, invalid or adjacent to explicit no-hold/no-stop/no-ARC rescue boundaries.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Selected because card 28 is the remaining directly implementable portfolio-set decision and connects the turnover/value findings to real shared admission.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Unit 079 closed the cost-shape proxy ambiguous; no further cost proxy outranks a direct intervention.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 plus all heights. Do not automatically open combined removal, another component, a threshold, allocation, slot, risk or Live successor.

fixed_metrics.removed_component_bookkeeping: For each candidate, exclude the same removed component from the NATIVE remaining-five comparator; never credit its mechanically absent losses or costs as released-capacity value.

requirements: The declaration, baseline commit/manifest and all five pinned evidence files remain exact.
The family source, configuration, compile receipt and runtime receipt are committed and pushed before the first Tester path and remain unchanged through all paths.
MetaEditor build 6140 reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.
All twelve paths stop normally, report 100 percent real ticks, use Model=4 and show no required-symbol detailed tick-generation fallback.
The dedicated runtime has no Live path, cross-family source/Include/EX5/SET/state/log link or shared mutable runtime dependency.
Every path logs the exact selected profile and finishes with zero safety, persistence, broker, foreign-exposure, protection, dropped-record or nonfinite-economic fault.
Each path has one durable close for every durable birth; report trades/deals and event-ledger topology reconcile exactly.
Every NATIVE component and every enabled candidate component has at least one birth in every period.
Stressed net is at least NATIVE and actual maximum equity drawdown is at most NATIVE simultaneously in at least three of four periods.
The sum of four independent-period stressed nets is at least the NATIVE sum.
No period's stressed net trails NATIVE by more than max(5 USD, 10 percent of absolute NATIVE stressed net).
Actual maximum equity drawdown is no more than 105 percent of NATIVE in every period.
Remaining-five stressed net exceeds its NATIVE remaining-five comparator pooled and in at least three of four periods.
Remaining-five births are at least NATIVE in at least three of four periods and at least 102 percent of NATIVE pooled.
Total durable births retain at least 85 percent of NATIVE pooled.
Risk-admission skips are no greater than NATIVE pooled and in at least three of four periods.
Pooled stop rate exceeds NATIVE by no more than 0.02.

fixed_selection_and_verdict_rules.one_candidate_passes: Select that frozen five-component profile as one future Lab candidate only.
fixed_selection_and_verdict_rules.two_candidates_pass: Select higher pooled stressed net, then lower sum of period equity drawdowns, then higher remaining-five births, then WITHOUT_PASSIVE.
fixed_selection_and_verdict_rules.falsified: NO_COMPONENT_REMOVAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_PASSED_PRESERVE_SIX_COMPONENTS when integrity passes and neither candidate passes.
fixed_selection_and_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_COMPONENT_REMOVAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_MATRIX_NO_VERDICT when any immutable, compile, isolation, real-tick, path, topology or density requirement fails.
fixed_selection_and_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_COMPONENT_REMOVAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_NO_CANDIDATE only for an unforeseen semantic condition after all declared integrity conditions pass.

decision_translation.complete: Freeze exactly one five-component future Lab candidate. No Live change or automatic confirmation is authorized.
decision_translation.falsified: Preserve the six-component forward baseline and close component removal without another subset.
decision_translation.ambiguous_or_invalid: Preserve the six-component forward baseline and make no component, capital, risk, slot, turnover or Live change.
